policy: Every host reachable from source must be declared here. Enforced by gate/egress_scan.py, which runs inside gate/verify.ps1.
doctrine_source: docs/ARCHESTRA_ADOPTION.md - allowlist enforced outside the guarded thing, never a convention or a model's judgement

fields.purpose: why code may reach this host
fields.untrusted_content: true when the response is attacker-influenced text (news, HTML, third-party feeds); the untrusted-content leg of the lethal trifecta
fields.live_trading: must be false everywhere; the constitution forbids live orders
